name: resopal-booster
description: In-world ResoPal panel: a UIX panel whose buttons fetch a deck or a booster pull and lay the cards out in front of you.

scripts.test: npm run graft:import && node verify-classpaths.mjs out/ResoPal_Panel_DeckImport.resonitepackage && node test-panel.mjs out/ResoPal_Panel_DeckImport.resonitepackage
scripts.test:graft-deck: npm run ship && npm run test:template && node test-graft-deck.mjs out/ResoPal_Panel_Deck.resonitepackage
scripts.ship: npm run template:deck && npm run graft:import && npm run graft:deck
scripts.template:deck: node build-deck-probe.mjs blank=52 mode=driven back=proxy src=../data/deck-template.resonitepackage out=out/ResoPal_DeckTemplate.resonitepackage
